Add a concrete Rust/Quint comparison for the existing reserve lifecycle: failed conditions preserve pending state while attempted work continues to accrue. Both consumers are checked against a separately frozen complete financial/work expectation.

Validation on `f15214ab7a885a4dc3194002cbacbb56841fdcbf`: new Rust regression 1 passed; continuation helper suite 5 passed; Quint 0.32.0 typecheck and one explicitly selected TypeScript deterministic test passed. The five actual captured ITF observations decode to exactly the Rust observations and independent oracle. Committed work is 11/11/26/26/36; cumulative attempted work is 11/15/30/32/42; final residual duty is 5.

Scope: one finite normal reserve trace and explicit bounded adapter. Initial/prefix Quint frames are pure assertions, separate from emitted lifecycle observations. No exhaustive invariant, circuit, native proof, ledger or target qualification. Fresh independent source/result review remains pending; this PR is draft. Root export parsing initially assumed the marker began a line; that evidence-handling error is retained and corrected without rerunning the consumers.
title: Compare reserve lifecycle across Rust and Quint with independent work accounting

body:
This adds a capped-remittance agreement that exercises quantity multiplication, both quantity-minimum branches and a zero fee through the public Rust Source/6 expander. A separate regression passes untouched Rust stdout to the real TypeScript Source/6 parser, lowerer and S0 preparer, then compares complete semantic ASTs, ordered effects and financial projections with independently frozen expectations.

Validation: the Rust regression passed on 34257f3ef95e7a1bf29031417e7f6d33f708f06a (1 passed, 7 filtered, 53.494 seconds). On 5acfebe651af47e8edd6741bba298d7336a03b0e the native-OFF binary build passed in 41.935 seconds and both new TypeScript pipeline cases passed in 0.202 seconds. Their captured outcomes are PreparedUnqualified; no ledger qualification is implied. Expected financial semantics were frozen before execution. Earlier fixtures and their freezes remain unchanged.

Draft: fresh review of the complete 31-path candidate and actual results is pending. Full language coverage, canonical Program/Artifact goldens, measured work, authentication and native/proof/ledger correspondence remain open.
title: Validate quantity-min transfers through Rust and Source6 consumers

body:
This implements Rust `mori lsp` diagnostics for the existing beta, Core/1 and Core/2 source profiles. The server supports initialization, full document updates, diagnostic clearing and normal shutdown, using the same parser/checker routes as `mori check`.

Validation: one real CLI protocol test passed on adff55f33942310123dc32f272cd6291e5b5c4da in 62.029 seconds. It compares nine complete semantic messages from eleven normal inputs, including a UTF16 diagnostic and edit/close clearing. Native features were disabled. Cargo resolved the three new registry dependencies from checksum-verified public source archives using a temporary offline directory source; existing package identities were preserved.

Draft: fresh full-source/result and designated security reviews are running. The normal test does not establish malformed-input handling, resource hardening or production security. No SDK/proof/ledger capability is claimed.
title: Implement Rust LSP diagnostics for existing source profiles
